finding: The structured handoff condition had the highest mean pilot score at 79.45, compared with 76.67 for the transcript and 45.00 for compressed memory.
interpretation: This pilot supports testing structured continuation records further. It does not establish model rankings or prove that formatting alone caused the score difference.

execution.retryPolicy: No retries. Responses that failed strict JSON parsing were recorded and scored as missing.
execution.scoring: Exact match for single-value fields and set F1 for multi-value fields. No LLM judge.

caveats: The three cases are authored English-language simulations.
The conditions intentionally retain different amounts of information.
Output-schema adherence affected scores; four Anthropic responses used fenced JSON and one OpenAI response returned candidate text instead of candidate IDs.
A single run per system is not enough to estimate variance.
Handover created the benchmark and benefits if structured handoffs perform well.
